intro: Financial services and government sectors bore the brunt of a concentrated phishing wave tracked in 53 articles from April 8 to April 30, 2026. Threat actors Silver Fox, Bluekit, and FakeWallet were observed, with 45 high-severity and 8 medium-severity incidents. Key exploited vulnerabilities included CVE-2023-22515, CVE-2023-34048, CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2023-4966, and CVE-2024-21893. The campaign impacted regions globally, with notable activity in Latin America, Canada, the Caribbean, and the United States, affecting sectors such as hospitality, cryptocurrency, and finance.
